title: Lead-Based Paint Disclosure (Pre-1978)
description: Federal law (42 USC 4852d) requires sellers and landlords of pre-1978 housing to disclose known lead-based paint hazards. Buyers receive a 10-day window to conduct risk assessment.

required_actions.note: Buyer/tenant has 10 calendar days to inspect for lead paint hazards.

title: RESPA Loan Estimate and Closing Disclosure
description: Lenders must provide Loan Estimate within 3 business days of application and Closing Disclosure 3 business days before consummation for RESPA-covered loans.

required_actions.note: Within 3 business days of loan application.

title: FIRPTA Withholding for Foreign Sellers
description: Buyer must withhold 15% of gross sales price (10% if price <= $1M and buyer uses as primary residence) when seller is a foreign person under FIRPTA.

required_actions.note: Buyer withholds 15% (or 10% if price <= $1M, primary residence). Remit to IRS within 20 days of transfer.

title: FinCEN Geographic Targeting Order — All-Cash Reporting
description: FinCEN GTOs require title insurance companies to identify and report beneficial owners of legal entities purchasing residential real estate with all-cash in designated metro areas.

required_actions.note: Title company must file FinCEN report if in a designated metro area.
